scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and haven't heard anything yet.
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application, ID LOAN-00832, has been denied.

dialogue.user: Oh no, denied? That's really disappointing. Can you tell me why it was denied? I thought everything was in order.
dialogue.agent: The principal reasons for the denial are your debt-to-income ratio and other factors.

dialogue.user: My debt-to-income ratio? I'm not entirely sure what that means or how it factored into the denial. Could you explain that a bit more?
dialogue.agent: The debt-to-income ratio, or DTI, is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. This is a key factor in loan underwriting. Your DTI was over 60%.

dialogue.user: Over 60%? Wow, that does sound high. I didn't realize it was that much. So, because of that, the application was denied. Is that correct?
dialogue.agent: Yes, that is correct. Your debt-to-income ratio was a principal reason for the denial of your application.

dialogue.user:
Okay, I understand. That's a shame, but I appreciate you explaining it. Since the application was denied, I don't think I have any other questions.

<Dissatisfied> I'm pretty disappointed with the outcome, and I wish I had understood more about how my DTI would impact the application beforehand.
